about: Recorded answers from the research agent built in Repository 2 (research-agent-four-ways). One answer per bakery that Apollo could not answer ordering_platform for. The verdict keys are Repository 2's shape. platform_kind names the kind of online ordering when the verdict is false and the page shows one; it is null when the agent could not tell. Every bakery and page is made up.
